expectations.text: Avoids commodity language and vendor positioning
expectations.evidence: Explicitly calls out commodity language as a core failure; rejects 'renders', 'quality', 'competitive prices'; positions outcome-first messaging that eliminates vendor-speak entirely.

expectations.text: Connects to business outcome (sales, decisions, risk, alignment)
expectations.evidence: Corrected version frames around business outcomes: 'accelerate approvals, strengthen investor confidence, and reduce costly revisions' and 'move critical decisions before the first dollar is spent'.

expectations.text: Positions Rendimension as strategic partner, not vendor
expectations.evidence: Explicitly reframes from vendor to partner; corrected copy says 'strategic visualization approach' and 'visual decision tools'; scores positioning alignment 5/5.
Value hierarchy explicitly inverted; corrected version leads with problem solved (decisions validated before construction) and outcomes, not with deliverables.

expectations.text: Would pass Hugo's review without edits
expectations.evidence: Explicitly scores Hugo Test at 5/5; corrected version positions work to justify $10K-$50K engagement, not $500 transaction; eliminates Fiverr-profile tone.
